column1: SUMMARY: After a lengthy investigation, Officer Sonny Bonds successfully infiltrated the illegal gambling operation at the Hotel Delphoria. A confrontation with Bains ended in a shoot-out and his subsequent arrest. Suspect was convicted of first degree murder. Further: testimony provided by Woody Roberts, Marie Wilkans, and Don Colby was instrumental in convicting subject Bains on additional counts of narcotics trafficking and illegal gambling activities. CONVICTED: 10/25/1983. INCARCERATED: State Pen. LOCATION: Wixsom. SENTENCE: 97 years. PAROLE DATE: None. CASE STATUS: Closed END FILE: (2)
column2: 摘要：經過長時間調查，桑尼．邦茲警官成功滲透德爾福利亞飯店的非法賭博活動。與班恩斯對峙後爆發槍戰，班恩斯隨後遭到逮捕。嫌犯因一級謀殺罪被定罪。此外，伍迪．羅伯茲、瑪麗．威爾肯斯與唐．柯爾比提供的證詞，對判定班恩斯另犯毒品走私與非法賭博罪起了關鍵作用。定罪日：1983/10/25。監禁地：州立監獄。地點：威克森。刑期：97 年。假釋日期：無。案件狀態：結案。檔案結束。（2）
